convert_config_to_fsdp2: convert an accelerate FSDP1 YAML config dictionary to FSDP2 format with updated argument names and values
to_fsdp2_command: run the CLI command to convert a YAML accelerate config from FSDP1 to FSDP2 with overwrite or output file options
to_fsdp2_command_parser: build a CLI argument parser for the to-fsdp2 subcommand with config_file, overwrite, and output_file arguments
load_config: load and parse a YAML accelerate configuration file into a Python dictionary
convert_config_to_fsdp2_skip: convert an accelerate config to FSDP2 while skipping removed and not-yet-implemented FSDP arguments
